summary: NextNRG filed an 8-K to disclose a $1,000,000 venture debt loan from Venture Debt, LLC. Net proceeds were $930,000 after a $70,000 origination fee. The loan carries $450,000 interest (203.17% APR), repaid in 24 weekly $60,417 installments through October 13, 2026. Prepayment allows a 25% interest reduction. Covenants restrict additional high-interest debt. This is a routine financing agreement, not a special situation. No premium, stake, or strategic event is involved. Watch for default triggers or refinancing under the restrictive covenants, but no risk-arb opportunity exists.
